line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: Retain explicit invocation context and BOOL outcome: registered_cleanup consumes wow_user_task_lifecycle_exit status; native procedure replacement can fail and records object_release_failed. Writing the copied WND alone leaves live callbacks installed. DestroyClass can reject a still-live native class: returning failure prevents a loop on the unchanged class-list entry. The procedure_is_guest discriminator, bounds of spfnwp, and original cleanup order remain intact. Matched indentation of the second DestroyClass failure return to its enclosing condition. No C tokens or line numbers changed.

verification.scope: Inspected original/current complete diff, registration callback, provider failure path and prior P242 controls. Verified whitespace-only byte edit, final hashes, #error pairing and logical line match. No runtime rerun.
